source.title: LECKER • Smart Cafe — Prototype UI/UX (Customer · Staff · Admin)
source.provenance: User-supplied native Figma export and two original frame PNG exports. Both frames were also inspected in the Figma browser UI.
source.documentScope: The native .fig contains the full prototype. The two PNG references cover DT2-8 desktop frames.

verifiedDesignValues.source: Figma browser properties and supplied frame exports

approvedOverrides.behavior: Staff can read invoices. Revenue statistics and printing controls require Admin.
Keep the implemented revenue charts, payment-method breakdown, filters and reconciliation logic. The statistical sample image is a layout reference.
Keep search by ID/date, show-all, pagination and creator data even where the prototype omits them.

usage.default: Read this manifest and the local frame PNG files before remote Figma access for DT2-8 UI work.
usage.nativeFile: Use the native source for deeper inspection. PNG exports are viewable without Figma.
usage.refresh: Refresh the bundle when the owner supplies an updated design. Update file hashes after replacing exports.
usage.sampleData: Prototype names, invoice amounts and chart values are reference content. Application business values come from its APIs.
